llm-backend-latency.description: Five-minute per-backend APIM latency; managed-identity failover only.

allOf.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(5m)
| where _ResourceId =~ '/subscriptions/10564893-ecc3-4a6d-b505-53bcbe89dd8e/resourceGroups/rg-svhwb107-apim-lab/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/apim-svhwb107-0915' and ApiId == 'llm'
| where Method == 'POST'
| extend BackendRequestUrl = tostring(split(tostring(BackendUrl), "?")[0])
| extend Backend = case(BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw-openai-eastus2.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-5.1/chat/completions', 'eastus2', BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw-openai-eastus2.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', 'eastus2', BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw-openai-eastus2.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses', 'eastus2', BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw2-swedencentral.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-5.1/chat/completions', 'sweden', BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw2-swedencentral.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', 'sweden', BackendRequestUrl == 'https://svhw2-swedencentral.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses', 'sweden', '')
| where Backend in ('eastus2', 'sweden')
| extend GatewayStatus = coalesce(toint(ResponseCode), 0),
    BackendStatus = coalesce(toint(BackendResponseCode), 0)
| where GatewayStatus !in (401, 403) and BackendStatus !in (401, 403)
| summarize Samples = count(), AverageBackendMs = avg(todouble(BackendTime)),
    ErrorCount = countif(GatewayStatus == 429 or GatewayStatus between (500 .. 599)
        or BackendStatus == 429 or BackendStatus between (500 .. 599))
    by Backend
| extend ErrorRatePct = 100.0 * ErrorCount / Samples
| extend ViolationCount = iff(Samples >= 5 and AverageBackendMs >= 3200, 1, 0)
| project Backend, ViolationCount
